name: Particle Flair Burst
description: Full-screen canvas where a swirling spiral of image particles converges to the center while shrinking and rotating in an endless staggered loop. Click to pause or resume.
contents: Full-viewport canvas with image particles on a solid background
behavior: GSAP timeline loops particles from a spiral ring to the center, scaling down and rotating
Particles are re-sorted by scale each frame so larger ones draw on top
Click or tap on the canvas pauses or resumes the motion

props.name: imageUrlPattern
props.default: flair image URL function cycling 21 sample images

editableByProps: Background color, particle images and count
Duration, easing, stagger, scale and rotation range, spiral radius
Click to pause on or off

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the spiral shape of the particle start positions
needsCodeEdit.where: fromTo x and y functions using angle * 10

fixed: Canvas is sized to the window, not the container, so it is meant to fill the viewport
Particle images load from the URLs given by imageUrlPattern
